scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large building with a tree planted in front of it. The building has a beige stone facade with balconies on each floor. There are people walking on the sidewalk and a black canopy set up in front of the building. The street is paved with asphalt and has white markings indicating pedestrian crossings and bike lanes. A small tree is planted in the median between the two streets. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building has a beige stone facade with balconies on each floor. It is at least five stories tall. The ground floor has a large wooden door with a rounded archway. The second through fifth floors have windows with brown shutters. The top floor has a balcony with a railing.
scene_analysis.materials: The building's facade is made of beige stone with decorative carvings around the windows and doors. The ground floor has a smooth granite base. The second through fifth floors have a rougher texture. The top floor has a metal railing.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables outside the building. They are placed under the canopy. There are also several trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There is a small tree planted in the median between the two streets. It is surrounded by a small patch of grass and flowers.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the building, including a sign that says 'Café' and another that says 'Bar'. There are also several street signs and traffic lights.
scene_analysis.as_resident: This area is likely a popular spot for locals and tourists alike. People seem to be enjoying the outdoor seating area.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: This area is likely a busy spot for commuters. The café and seating area provide a convenient spot to grab a coffee or snack before heading to work.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: This area is likely a popular spot for tourists. The architecture and landscaping make it a pleasant place to visit.
scene_analysis.as_student: This area is likely a popular spot for students. The café and seating area provide a comfortable spot to study or relax.
